milestone.name: V5 Repository Authentication Issue - Token Access Problem Identified

authentication_issue.error_details: Authentication failed for the new repository organization

likely_causes: Token does not have access to momento-group1 organization
Token may be expired or invalid
User permissions may not include new organization

recommended_solutions: Generate new Personal Access Token with access to momento-group1
Verify repository exists and user has permissions
Check token scope includes write_repository for new organization
next_steps: Generate new token if new repository access is required
Coordinate with team for repository migration
Update repository URL when access is confirmed
conclusion: Repository authentication issue identified when attempting to update to new GitLab organization. The existing token does not have access to the momento-group1/MomentoAVFSCore repository. Repository URL has been reverted to the original avfsmomentoserver1 repository to maintain Git operations. New authentication credentials or repository access verification is required before completing the repository migration.
